content: Control Panel for Twitter organizes settings into: Home Timeline (default to Following, hide For You tab, move or hide Retweets and Quote Tweets), Content Hiding (See new Tweets button, Who to follow, Follow some topics, Premium upsells, blocked or muted quote hiding), UI and Navigation (typography and density, sidebar item toggles for DMs, Explore, Subscriptions, Grok), and Engagement Management (hide all metrics, reduced interaction mode, hide compose button, disable home timeline). Applies changes live via an options page.
